sources.title: bx6d/r2s2r-pushing-diverse400 · Datasets at Hugging Face
sources.snippet: The tennis ball diameter is 65 mm. The measured v2 pick-and-place model uses a 220×220×70 mm box (outer dimensions) and a cylindrical battery 32 mm in diameter and 58 mm high. Unmeasured wall thicknesses, mass and friction remain estimates; see object_measurements.json. Pushing uses the approved cube/bowl references.

sources.title: bx6d/r2s2r-blue-cube-to-bowl-diverse400 - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: xArm6 cube-to-bowl: diverse400 400 training demonstrations, selected from the training split of bx6d/r2s2r-blue-cube-to-bowl-expanded. Task: "Pick up the blue cube and place it in the bowl." The400 contain 392,152 action timesteps and 392,552 two-camera observation pairs.

sources.title: Physical Intelligence (π): Models, openpi and Pi API (Oct 2026)
sources.snippet: Physical Intelligence, which writes its name as π, is a robotics AI company building one model that can control many kinds of robots. Its models are called π0, π0.5, π*0.6 and π0.7. As of October 19, 2026, you can download three of them for free: π0, π0-FAST and π0.5 are in the openpi GitHub repository under the Apache-2.0 license. The newer models are not open.
